title: Software Engineer
description: During my time in Traveloka's Corporate Travel unit, I focused on developing accommodation and core features on the front-end. I led the mobile web initiative to create adaptive, mobile-friendly interfaces for the entire booking and payment flow. Additionally, I architected a Session ID-based authentication flow using S3 and session storage, enabling HRIS clients to seamlessly access the corporate platform. I primarily worked with React.js, React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript.

title: Software Engineer (Contract)
description: As the sole Front-end Engineer for Zora Health Singapore, I collaborated closely with product managers and designers to build the user interface from scratch. I developed their e-learning, appointment booking, e-commerce, and admin dashboard platforms, which played a key role in securing $1 million SGD in seed funding. I built these platforms using React.js, Golang, Sass, and TypeScript.

title: Associate Software Development Engineer
description: During my time at Sirclo, I worked alongside cross-functional teams to build modern e-commerce templates and enhance the admin panel. I used React.js, Next.js, and Sass modules to create the templates, and improved the administration side by building a subscription cart, revamping the registration UI, and adding phone verification for admins.
